instruction:
Create a complete page with the following structure:

1. Write an <h1> header that says "Hello Webibo"
2. Next, write a <p> paragraph that says "Learning is fun!"
3. After that, write an <h2> header that says "Welcome to Webibo"
4. Finally, write a <p> paragraph "Let's build something amazing together."
correct_code:
Hello Webibo

Learning is fun!

Welcome to Webibo

Let's build something amazing together.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: You've mastered headings and paragraphs! You created a proper HTML structure with an <h1>, <h2>, and two <p> tags. Great job!

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details:
Remember the structure:
1. <h1>Hello Webibo</h1>
2. <p>Learning is fun!</p>
3. <h2>Welcome to Webibo</h2>
4. <p>Let's build something amazing together.</p>
